title: Counterexamples to the Two-Bases Conjecture for the Tutte Polynomial
summary: We disprove the two-bases conjecture of Chávez-Lomelí, Merino, Noble, and Ramírez-Ibañez (Conjecture 5.8 in *Some Inequalities for the Tutte Polynomial*), which asserts that \(\max\{T_M(2,0),T_M(0,2)\}\ge T_M(1,1)\) whenever a matroid contains two disjoint bases or its ground set is the union of two bases.
